biological_mechanism: Direct physical interaction; GRP78 binds the luminal domain of PERK (EIF2AK3) to keep it monomeric and inactive; ER stress or competitive binding induces GRP78 dissociation, triggering PERK dimerization and autophosphorylation.
Direct physical interaction; GRP78 shields ATF6 Golgi-localization signals in ER lumen; upon dissociation, ATF6 translocates to Golgi for S1P/S2P proteolytic cleavage and nuclear activation.

Direct physical interaction; GRP78 maintains IRE1 (ERN1) in an inactive monomeric state; dissociation induces oligomerization, endoribonuclease activation (XBP1 splicing), and TRAF2-mediated JNK activation.
GRP78 interacts with and stabilizes AKT phosphorylation at the plasma membrane and ER; cell-surface GRP78 acts as a co-receptor facilitating downstream PI3K/Akt activation.
Metabolic stress and glucose deprivation modulate GRP78-AMPK crosstalk; GRP78 assists in maintaining cellular ATP levels and interacts during metabolic remodeling.
Functional coupling via IRE1-TRAF2 axis; ER stress releases GRP78 from IRE1, triggering downstream JNK (MAPK8) activation and serine phosphorylation of IRS1.

pathway_name: De Novo Lipogenesis & ER Lipid Sensing
biological_mechanism: GRP78 regulates ER lipid bilayer stress and interacts with the SREBP cleavage-activating protein (SCAP)/SREBP-1c regulatory complex, controlling lipogenic gene transcription.
Direct primary substrate phosphorylation; activated INSR phosphorylates IRS1 on multiple tyrosine residues to recruit PI3K p85 subunit.
Primary alternative substrate phosphorylation; activated INSR recruits and phosphorylates IRS2, driving hepatic and peripheral insulin signal transduction.
AKT1 operates downstream of INSR via PI3K/PDK1; phosphorylates downstream metabolic targets including GSK3 and FOXO1.
IRS1 acts upstream of AKT1 through PI3K/PIP3 generation; AKT and downstream mTOR/S6K mediate negative feedback serine phosphorylation on IRS1.
Active JNK (MAPK8) directly phosphorylates IRS1 at inhibitory serine residue Ser307, uncoupling IRS1 from INSR and inducing severe cellular insulin resistance.
Activated IRE1alpha recruits TRAF2 and ASK1 to directly phosphorylate and activate JNK (MAPK8), providing the primary biochemical bridge linking ER stress to insulin desensitization.
AMPK (PRKAA1) directly phosphorylates SREBP-1c at Ser372, inhibiting its proteolytic cleavage and nuclear translocation, thereby suppressing hepatic steatosis.
AKT/mTORC1 pathway promotes SREBP-1c processing and nuclear translocation, stimulating lipogenic gene expression under hyperinsulinemic conditions.
ER stress signaling cross-talk; PERK-eIF2alpha phosphorylation attenuates general translation while modulating IRS1 turnover.
Functional co-regulation of hepatic insulin signaling; IRS1 predominantly coordinates glucose metabolism whereas IRS2 directs lipid homeostasis.
